verdict.rationale: Exa's own docs cover the whole flow through one API. Search returns clean page content and relevance-ranked extracts in a single request, at no extra charge for up to 10 results (exa-docs-22, exa-docs-35, exa-docs-2). The Contents API handles JS-rendered pages and PDFs (exa-docs-24). Exa Agent and deep research run iterative search, reasoning and grounded, cited synthesis, and agents can reach all of this through the SDK or the official MCP server (exa-docs-25, exa-docs-26, exa-gh-8, exa-docs-6). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end Agent/deep-research flow (community reports cover Websets, not this pipeline).
